title: Agent and Skill Design
summary: Define FlowDoc agent roles, capabilities, handoffs, and reusable skills after the documentation authority cleanup evidence by turning root-cause analysis into operating rules, role overlays, handoff requirements, and reusable skill boundaries.
expectedOutput: Project Control commit 807ea854868b3ac35d5ac5bfdc09074345318928 records FlowDoc agent documentation authority operating rules that explain why product-repository Markdown drift happened, define the Markdown Authority Pre-Action Gate, route future agents through Project Control before writing Markdown, and keep broader reusable skill packaging for later phases.
